name: Kaji Shouto
source:
Shouto is a student at Yotsuya Bridge Academy and Lamia and Camilla's classmate.

Driven out of his parents' house, and lives alone in an apartment.
He has a part-time job at a gas station, but he also gets allowance from his parents.

Shouto's behavior at school isn't very good.
He sits next to Lamia in the classroom, he is also joined the astronomy club in order to follow Lamia and Camilla.

Things that interest him: Customizing his scooter.
His weak school subjects: Everything.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
